parse_log: parse a pytest log string and return a dictionary mapping test case names to their status
test_passed: check if a specific test case passed by looking it up in the parsed test status map
test_failed: check if a specific test case failed or errored by looking it up in the parsed test status map
review_parse_log: review the parse_log function to understand how it extracts test case names and statuses from pytest output
summarize_TestStatus: summarize the TestStatus enum and its FAILED, PASSED, SKIPPED, and ERROR values
